architecture.summary: Distributed system with the EVO X2 as the primary host. EVO runs the Node.js bot runtime, WhatsApp, HTTP API, scheduler, memory integration, and local AI services. The Pi is a native Rust dashboard and backup screen, while the laptop-hosted Clawd Console provides the richer web control surface. Two-tier cloud AI with local support: MiniMax M2.7 (default cloud) for most chat responses, Claude Opus 4.6 for premium or explicit-request paths. Local compute on EVO handles classification, planning support, vision, document summarisation, and embeddings — not the main chat response.

devices.name: Raspberry Pi 5
devices.runs: Rust native dashboard on the 10.1 inch touchscreen. Connects to the EVO-hosted bot API and SSE feed over the direct ethernet link.
devices.display: 10.1 inch touchscreen, 1024x600, runs Rust native dashboard

devices.name: EVO X2 NucBox
devices.role: Primary bot runtime, local AI, memory, and voice host
devices.hardware: AMD Ryzen AI Max+ 395 (16C/32T), Radeon 8060S (RDNA 3.5, 40 CUs, gfx1151), 128GB unified LPDDR5X (96GB GPU VRAM heap via UMA, ~32GB CPU-visible — do NOT use free/meminfo to judge model capacity, check /sys/class/drm/card1/device/mem_info_vram_total)
devices.runs: Node.js clawdbot runtime via systemd (WhatsApp, HTTP API on port 3000, scheduler, tools, ambient agency), Python voice listener (clawdbot-voice.service), llama.cpp with Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B (vision and document support, port 8080), Qwen3-4B (primary classifier/planner signal, port 8085), Qwen3-0.6B (last-resort fallback classifier, port 8081), Granite-Docling-258M F16 (structured document parsing, port 8084), Qwen3-Embedding-8B Q8_0 (4096-dim embeddings, port 8083), memory service on port 5100, and SearXNG on port 8888.

devices.name: Clawd Console
devices.framework: Next.js 16 web app (separate from the Pi dashboard)
devices.layout: Overview, overnight intelligence, routing, memory browser, logs, and mission-control style diagnostics.
devices.connectivity: Runs locally on port 3100 and proxies requests to the EVO bot API and memory service using DASHBOARD_TOKEN auth.
